comments.text:
Closing as obsolete. Token telemetry is now consumed by multiple downstream systems:

- Compaction: `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/compaction/tokens.ex` (`estimate_context_tokens/1` uses `Usage.total_tokens`); driven via `extensions/trigger_compact.ex`.
- TUI footer dashboard: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/footer.ex` renders input/output/cache tokens and cost.
- Cost tracking: `apps/octo_pi_ai/lib/octo_pi/ai/usage/cost.ex`.
- Session persistence: usage serialized via `message_reader.ex` / `message_writer.ex`.

Tracer still attaches a logging handler (`apps/octo_pi_tracer/lib/octo_pi/tracer.ex`), but it now coexists with real consumers rather than being the only sink. Original premise no longer holds.

description: Both Anthropic and OpenAI telemetry handlers delegate to TelemetryLogger, which only logs events as [telemetry] name key: value to Logger.info when enabled. The token counts (input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens) are emitted but never consumed for any downstream purpose — no cost tracking, no compaction decisions, no dashboards.\n\nFix: Either build a proper telemetry consumer (e.g. a cost aggregator or stats collector) or remove the dead telemetry emission code. At minimum, ensure the token data flows somewhere useful.
title: Act on AI telemetry token counts instead of just logging them
